purpose: Record explicit approval of Bella MXF Duration requirements, including the preceding DF separator clarification, before reviewing MXF Frame Rate.
status: Approved requirements; unimplemented. No application cutover or Bin Filter change.

authorization.source: Direct human approval in the current conversation
authorization.statement: OK, let's lock those Duration rules in for Bella. Next, how do Media Composer, MDVX and MediaMuster read Frame Rate from MXF, and what should Bella read and keep?
authorization.scope: Approves the focused MXF Duration field, clock, missing-value, numbering and retention rules, with DF semicolons/NDF colons as clarified immediately beforehand. New Frame Rate mappings and other pending field/navigation proposals are not approved by this request.

agreedBellaRules.physicalPair: Already qualified essence-linked physical file descriptor ContainerDuration and same-descriptor SampleRate together. Preserve full signed64 nonnegative count and exact positive numerator/denominator; no master/source segment count substitution.
agreedBellaRules.missingDamagedPair: Leave MXF Duration unavailable when this pair is missing, damaged, conflicting or not safely owned; retain the physical file and independent facts. No own-track length recovery in this first-release rule.
agreedBellaRules.unitMeaning: Preserve exact recorded units, samples where supported units genuinely count samples and native units otherwise. AudioSamplingRate is separate; do not universally replace the physical divisor or halve interlaced rates.
agreedBellaRules.displayClock: Video uses its supported own frame/editing clock with known sample-unit interpretation. Audio uses usable recorded Preface.ProjectEditRate from the same active physical header. Missing/damaged required display timing leaves formatted Duration blank. Audio visible Frame Rate remains blank.
agreedBellaRules.numbering: Validate known MXF Boolean0/1, nominal timecode base, exact clock and applicable range. Follow relevant explicit file-source references with full-ID/track/range/boundary/cycle checks. Apply qualified recorded DF; NDF for proven applicable absence; blank for damaged/unresolved relevant numbering. Known NDF-only clocks need no DF search. Do not add StartTimecode.
agreedBellaRules.maths: Use exact MXF rationals directly, keeping the legacy MDB rate interpretation source-specific. Preserve precise count/sample values and use the agreed integer/fraction maths and final nearest/half-up audio display-frame rounding.
agreedBellaRules.format: NDF HH:MM:SS:FF; DF HH;MM;SS;FF. Known zero and legitimate positive audio rounded to zero use the selected mode separators. Unavailable required data stays blank; hours can exceed24 without wrap.
agreedBellaRules.retention: Only selected exact count/rate, necessary display clock, qualified numbering mode and compact availability. Share wanted audio/wrapping facts with other fields; release temporary bytes, candidates and relationship indexes. One shared formatter after source-aware interpretation, expressed in fresh small C++17/Qt6.5 helpers.
agreedBellaRules.sourceBoundary: Keep usable MDB Duration first. Coherent own MXF Duration is eligible only on the already agreed database-unavailable fallback. No Duration-only header open, routine MDB/header comparison or hybrid count/rate/clock/flag. Full source-priority/header-open review remains deferred.

verificationBoundary: The selected thirteen actual headers corroborate own count/rate, eight video clocks and five audio Preface display clocks. Three fractional zero-start/origin source-timecode ranges are qualified. Nonzero cross-rate audio source-position mapping and uncommon wrapping/layout/damage cases need implementation verification; approval is not universal native GUI parity or scope expansion.
unchanged: Existing independent Bella implementation and explicit app cutover approval.
OldScanner stays active and Bin Filter remains outside this work.
Compression behavior and already approved identity/name/Project/Kind rules.
Other formats, MXF navigation/concurrency and new Frame Rate-specific capability rules remain separate work.
supersedes: Earlier pending/proposed status of the focused MXF Duration rules. Historical source findings and arithmetic illustrations remain unchanged, with the prior separator revision authoritative for rendered punctuation.
